docs.author: Dr. Alan Whitcombe
sentences: Patient is a 42-year-old woman with low back pain for about three months.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Reports numbness and tingling along the outer left calf.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

sentences: Sleeps about six hours a night.

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1006 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document an objective neurological deficit. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
